item.title: Does Iran have the military capacity to sustain retaliatory strikes against US, Israel?
item.description: Tehran still has a substantial ballistic missile inventory but is it enough to stand up to the might of the US? Experts weigh in.

item.title: US-Israel strike on Iran may drag Middle East into ring of fire: President Erdogan
item.description: Türkiye’s president condemns both US–Israeli attacks on Iran and Tehran’s retaliation, urging urgent diplomacy to avert wider regional war.

item.title: Israel shuts Rafah, seals Gaza off again as joint strikes with US on Iran raise fears of wider war
item.description: Border closure after joint Israel–US strikes on Iran deepens isolation for Palestinians already enduring catastrophic humanitarian conditions and mounting legal scrutiny over Israel’s conduct in Gaza.

item.title: Trump claims Iran didn't really want a deal, signals military action may end in a few days
item.description: US president says he could extend the military offensive and “take over everything,” or end it in a few days.

item.title: Iran dismisses claims by US and Israel that Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei is dead
item.description: Foreign Ministry rejects claims of Netanyahu and Trump, saying Supreme Leader Khamenei and President Pezeshkian both are "safe and sound".

item.title: 'We voted for America First and ZERO wars': Trump's Iran strike sparks backlash from MAGA base
item.description: Conservative commentator Tucker Carlson calls US-Israel attacks on Iran "absolutely disgusting and evil," while Marjorie Taylor Greene blasts Trump administration for breaking campaign promises about foreign wars.

item.title: US-Israeli attack on Minab school killed 100+ children, Iran envoy tells UNSC
item.description: Amir Saeid Iravani says it's regrettable some UNSC members apply "double standards", disregarding US and Israeli aggression while criticising Iran's right to self-defence under UN Charter.

item.title: Ali Khamenei, family members, killed in US-Israel attacks, confirms Iran
item.description: Tehran vows to avenge its supreme leader's killing and announces 40 days of public mourning.

item.title: Iranians flood Iran’s streets after Israel‑US attacks killed Ali Khamenei
item.description: Iranians react with mass protests and mourning after Supreme Leader Khamenei was killed in US and Israeli strikes.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 1 March
item.description: Israel and the United States launch air strikes on Iran killing Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. And, Turkish President Erdogan says Middle East risks becoming a ring of fire without diplomacy... listen for more
